verdict.rationale: Lithic is a card-issuing/payments API platform, not an agent or orchestration tool that itself consumes MCP servers' tools; the evidence instead shows the reverse direction — Lithic ships an MCP server so AI editors (Cursor, Claude Code) can call Lithic's own API tools (lithic-docs-1, lithic-docs-14, lithic-probe-3). There is no plausible product surface for Lithic to 'plug in' external MCP servers and use their tools, making this a category error rather than a missing feature.
